facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: improvement notice - material unwanted event control at HO-9402

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work on HO-9402 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear on HO-9402 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the preparation and approval of a lift study on HO-9402 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically preparing and approving a lift study. HO-9402 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 29 January 2023 a regulatory notice was issued concerning HO-9402 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop following shift handover.
